QuestInfo.name: Light Reborn
QuestInfo.0:
As the Knight of Light, I serve as guardian to the Empress.
I must go visit Cygnus the Empress, whom I am charged to protect.
QuestInfo.1: A sublime light guards the Empress. If you are ready to accept your fate and become that light, go to Her Highness.
QuestInfo.2: A sublime light guards the Empress. I shall be born again as that light. And now, I'll begin life anew as #rGuardian of the Empress Cygnus#k.
